finding: Audited empirical convergence trajectories and contraction ratios across R3 and R4: R4 Step 1 (+10 nm trial) exhibited steady geometric contraction (rho ~ 0.8822, std < 0.0004) without nonlinear stagnation, truncated prematurely by max_outer=50 when delta_H reached 1.52e-4 MPa; R3 Step 1 required 74 outers to converge (unconverged at outer 50 with delta_H = 4.82e-5 MPa); R4 Step 2 (+5 nm) halved initial perturbation by 51.3% (rho ~ 0.8614) with projected convergence at outer ~73; walltime feasibility confirms 100-120 outer iterations consume <= 1.8 hours, leaving > 6.2 hours of PBS walltime headroom.
